source_refs.note: Roman Urdu overview of the reactions of amines (PDF 122).

blocks.text: Amines ke reactions nitrogen atom ke lone pair se aate hain, jo unhein bases aur nucleophiles banata hai. Yeh hissa un ki basicity (24.3.1), nitrous acid se primary, secondary aur tertiary amines ki pehchan (24.3.2) aur phenylamine ke reactions (24.3.3) bayan karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Amine molecule ki kaun si khasiyat us ki basicity aur nucleophilic rawaiye dono ko samjhati hai?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen atom par electrons ka lone pair.

items: N ka lone pair amines ko bases aur nucleophiles banata.
